scripts.test:e2e: pnpm db:migrate:e2e && node scripts/prepare-e2e-account.mjs && playwright test --workers=1
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm docs:check && pnpm db:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:ui && pnpm test:setup && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm test:boundaries && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.db:migrate:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.e2e.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env local --file scripts/seed.sql
scripts.cf:deploy:production: pnpm cf:build:production && pnpm db:migrate:production && node scripts/deploy-if-current.mjs

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Leave empty to use the deployment's own URL. Set it to your canonical origin, such as `https://app.example.com`, once you add a custom domain or enable email reminders.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Leave empty: email is logged, not sent, and sign-up needs no verification. To send, set up [Cloudflare Email Service](https://developers.cloudflare.com/email-service/) and add an `EMAIL` binding first.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Leave empty for the first deploy: the sign-up challenge stays off. To use [Turnstile](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/), add its secret as the `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` Worker secret, then set the widget's site key here. A site key without the secret stops sign-in.

POSTHOG_HOST.description: Optional. Analytics stay off unless the `POSTHOG_KEY` secret is set.

AI_MODEL.description: The Workers AI model that breaks a task into subtasks. It runs on your Cloudflare account: Workers AI includes 10,000 Neurons a day on every plan, then costs $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons. One breakdown in the TanBase demo cost $0.000086.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: The AI Gateway that logs each AI request, with its cost. Cloudflare creates `default` on first use.

AI_DAILY_LIMIT.description: How many task breakdowns each person may start per day. Set it to 0 to turn AI off.

DB.description: Projects, tasks, and accounts. Migrations run on every deploy.
